mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0.00) FROM orders WHERE status = 'PAID' AND is_deleted = FALSE AND created_at >= #{startTime} AND created_at <= #{endTime}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'PAID' AND is_deleted = FALSE AND created_at >= #{startTime} AND created_at <= #{endTime}

SELECT oi.product_id AS productId, MAX(oi.product_name) AS productName, CAST(SUM(oi.quantity) AS SIGNED) AS quantitySold FROM order_item oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'PAID' AND o.is_deleted = FALSE AND o.created_at >= #{startTime} AND o.created_at <= #{endTime} GROUP BY oi.product_id ORDER BY quantitySold DESC, productId ASC LIMIT 5

SELECT id AS productId, name AS productName, stock, stock_alert_threshold AS stockAlertThreshold, status FROM product WHERE is_deleted = FALSE AND (stock <= stock_alert_threshold OR status = 'SOLD_OUT') ORDER BY CASE WHEN status = 'SOLD_OUT' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, stock ASC, id ASC
